component_height: height of the component in inches
component_width: width of the component in inches
component_floor_clearance: floor clearance of the component in inches
component_ceiling_clearance: ceiling clearance of the component in inches.
door_hinging_right: indicates whether the door is hinged on the right side when viewed from outside the stall
door_swinging_out: indicates whether the door swings outward into the bathroom
door_wall_post_hinging: indicates whether the door is hinged on a wall post
door_wall_post_latching: indicates whether the door latches to a wall post
door_wall_keep_latching: indicates whether the door latches to a wall keep
door_perp_stile_keeper: indicates whether the door latches on a perpendicular stile
floor_to_ceiling: indicates whether the stall is floor to ceiling or not
